title: Cage-only screenshot tool for pre-coons_patch debugging
description: Agent only sees final rendered mesh. Add mode to screenshot tool that renders cage pre-coons_patch (wireframe + flat-shaded quads). If bundle has _bezier_handles_start, render wireframe-cage and smoothed side-by-side. Reuse existing mesh viewer/automation server; parameter selects render mode. Add prompt blurb to use screenshot_cage for validation.
definition-of-done: 1. screenshot tool supports cage-only mode. 2. Output shows wireframe cage with handles. 3. Agent prompt mentions new capability.
testing-plan: 1. Call screenshot tool on a handled cage, verify wireframe output. 2. Call on coons_patch output, verify smooth mesh output (existing behavior).
